policy: Experimental player/minute associations, not causal injury values or calibrated betting adjustments. Recent five-game rotation is the reference; existing absences are not charged twice. Uncertain statuses get play/out scenarios, not assigned probabilities. Replacement minutes are redistributed among recent participants up to 48 each; announced starters/minute limits are not verified. Missing reports never mean healthy. No forecasts, probabilities, leans or stakes are changed.
